decision.explanation: Documents d1 and d2 explicitly state that the 2018 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to Peter Handke and Olga Tokarczuk respectively, presenting mutually exclusive claims for the same specific award year; the fallible prior correctly notes the real-world context where Handke was initially selected but the prize was withheld and later awarded to Tokarczuk, yet the provided text sources assert both as the awardees for 2018.
